text: The canteen dosa was crispy and the chutney tasted fresh, best breakfast I've had this week.
The bus to campus was forty minutes late again and nobody told us why.
I expected the lab exam to be terrible, but it turned out to be surprisingly easy.
Oh great, the Wi-Fi went down right before the submission deadline.
The new library reading room is quiet and has plenty of charging points.
The movie had stunning visuals, but the story was so boring I nearly fell asleep.
Not bad at all for a first attempt at a mobile app.
The hostel food has not improved one bit since last semester.
